summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K providing a translation of its monthly Share Buyback Report for May 2026. The filing details open-market repurchases under three board resolutions: a May 2025 resolution (max 100M shares / ¥250B, completed Oct 2025), a Feb 2026 resolution (max 90M shares / ¥250B, completed Mar 2026), and a new May 8, 2026 resolution authorizing up to 230M shares / ¥500B over one year. Repurchases in the reporting month are listed by trade date. This ongoing buyback returns capital to shareholders and reduces share count. Watch for further updates on execution pace and cumulative progress toward the new authorization.
